title: Agents
description: Configure bounded managed agents that inherit task permissions and workspace scope.
timing: Limits are captured when a root task first prepares managed agents and stay fixed for that tree, including reloads. Save applies new limits to later trees. Explicit only can narrow delegation for an open task; Proactive cannot widen a task's frozen explicit-only policy. New child launches capture their model/API profile; existing children keep their captured route.

concurrency.label: Maximum concurrent managed agents
concurrency.description: Live children across one root task and all nested descendants, excluding the root itself. Default: {{default}}; range: {{min}}–{{max}} agents. The separate maximum concurrent tasks setting can further restrict capacity.
concurrency.taskCapacity: Configured extension task capacity: {{capacity}} tasks, including root tasks, foreground and background sessions, and managed children. Available child slots depend on running tasks and the root tree's captured limit.

delegation.label: Delegation policy
delegation.description: Explicit only tells the agent to wait for your request to delegate; Proactive lets it choose delegation. Launch approval still follows Ask, Auto, or Full Access, and children keep the parent's bounded authority.

defaultProfile.label: Default child model/API profile
defaultProfile.description: Uses the provider, model, and reasoning settings from this profile unless a role, named type, or launch override selects another route. Model/API profiles do not grant tool or approval authority.

profile.missingWarning: The saved profile is unavailable. New launches fall back to the parent's profile. Choose another profile or inheritance to replace the saved reference.
profile.unconfiguredWarning: This profile has no configured provider. New launches fall back to the parent's profile.

depth.label: Maximum managed-agent depth
depth.description: Nesting within one root tree. Direct children have depth 1. Default: {{default}}; range: {{min}}–{{max}}. A larger limit does not grant delegation or write authority.

timeouts.title: Role timeouts
timeouts.label: {{role}} timeout per run (seconds)
timeouts.description: Wall-clock timeout for each active child run in this role, starting after a slot is acquired. Follow-up runs reuse the frozen duration. Measured in seconds and saved as milliseconds. Range: {{min}}–{{max}} seconds; defaults: Explore {{explore}}, Review {{review}}, Worker {{worker}}.

inputTokens.label: Input-token limit per child
inputTokens.description: Cumulative provider-reported input tokens for one child, including repeated context across requests. Default: {{default}}; range: {{min}}–{{max}} tokens.

outputTokens.label: Output-token limit per child
outputTokens.description: Cumulative provider-reported output tokens for one child across requests. Default: {{default}}; range: {{min}}–{{max}} tokens.

rootTokens.label: Token budget for one managed-agent tree
rootTokens.description: Aggregate input plus output tokens for all children and descendants, including completed agents. Excludes the root's own requests. Leave blank for no optional tree budget; range: {{min}}–{{max}} tokens.

rootCost.label: Cost budget for one managed-agent tree (USD)
rootCost.description: Aggregate provider-reported child cost for one root tree, including completed descendants. Excludes the root's own requests. Leave blank for no optional tree budget; otherwise use a positive amount.

budgetTiming: Token and cost limits stop agents when reported usage reaches a limit. Usage arrives after a provider request, so an in-flight request can exceed the remaining amount. Cost enforcement depends on provider cost reporting; these are not prepaid spending caps.

roleProfiles.title: Model/API profiles by role
roleProfiles.label: {{role}} model/API profile
roleProfiles.inherit: Use the default child profile, then the parent
roleProfiles.description: A role profile overrides the default child profile. Explore and Review remain read-only; Worker can edit only within authority inherited from a Code parent.

types.title: Named agent types
types.description: Define named types for agent launches. A type profile overrides role and default profiles. Existing model, reasoning, and instruction overrides are preserved when routing is edited. Up to 24 types are supported.
types.name: New agent type name
types.nameHint: Use a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens; maximum 64 characters.
types.inherit: Use the role profile, then the default child profile
types.instructionsOverride: This type has saved developer instructions.

validation.concurrency: Choose a whole number from 1 to 16 for concurrent managed agents.
validation.delegationPolicy: Choose Explicit requests only or Proactive delegation.
validation.depth: Choose a whole number from 1 to 5 for managed-agent depth.
validation.timeout: Use 10 to 3,600 seconds, with no more than three decimal places, for each role timeout.
validation.childTokens: Choose a whole number from 1 to 10,000,000 for each child token limit.
validation.rootTokens: Leave the tree token budget blank or choose a whole number from 1 to 10,000,000.
validation.rootCost: Leave the tree cost budget blank or enter a finite amount greater than zero.
validation.agentTypes: Use at most 24 valid agent types. Each needs a lowercase type name (up to 64 characters), a description of 1–500 characters, a supported role, and valid saved overrides.
validation.newType: Enter a unique valid type name and a description of 1–500 characters before adding it.
